answer: A farm of 399 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are published in thread, queued in trellis, and dune publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 67 identities per epoch. A farm of 1541 identities would post 899 proofs and burn roughly 16 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
